label: Every GOD_4 with intrinsic self-knowledge HAS_INTELLECT_1
paraphrase: OPEN recognition bridge, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: every g that is GOD_4 and has intrinsic self-knowledge (a true, actually apprehended, cognitively grounded content about itself) satisfies the unary HAS_INTELLECT_1. It reads such self-knowledge as sufficient for intellect; it does not say that intellect requires it.
